# MeterRowData.VoiceIcon field

Optional small status icon shown on the name line (e.g. team-voice mic/headphone/muted). MUST be a UnityEngine.Texture2D; a non-Texture2D renders nothing. Hidden unless [`ShowVoiceIcon`](./ShowVoiceIcon.md).
